# CamCash — AI-Powered Analytics for Cam Models

> CamCash ([camcashgrl.com](https://www.camcashgrl.com)) is a free
> analytics dashboard for cam models on Chaturbate, BongaCams,
> and MyFreeCams. It provides tip tracking, fan intelligence,
> session analysis, and live coaching.

## What CamCash Does
- Tracks individual tip events from CSV exports or live Chrome extension
- Identifies top spenders, churn risk, and fan lifetime value
- Shows peak earning hours and best streaming days
- Compares revenue per hour across platforms
- Provides AI-powered coaching during live streams
- Generates optimized room titles based on goals and mood

## Supported Platforms
- Chaturbate
- BongaCams
- MyFreeCams

## Blog Content
CamCash publishes guides and analytics content for
cam models covering earnings optimization, fan
retention, platform strategy, and business analytics.

## Target Audience
Independent cam models and live stream creators on
adult content platforms who want to grow their
income using data.
